summary: Iteration 2 — tested 3 new features (Google login, Apple Sign-In, multi-signal lead verification). Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases PASS plus existing 34/34 still pass = 43/43 total backend. New endpoints validated: POST /api/auth/google-session (invalid session_id → 401), POST /api/auth/apple (malformed JWT → 401, JWKS roundtrip works), POST /api/leads/{id}/verify (populates poster_profile/poster_trust/freshness using demo data since Reddit blocked from this container — alive=true, karma+age+label all populated, deterministic via demo_poster_profile), POST /api/leads/{id}/mark-verified (toggles user in verified_by, increments/decrements verified_count, awards +3 XP first time), GET /api/leads/{id} now returns spam_score/spam_flags/verified_by/i_verified/verified_count fields. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Login screen shows CONTINUE WITH GOOGLE button correctly above email/password form; Apple button correctly HIDDEN on web (Platform.OS !== 'ios'); clicking Google redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fai-outreach-17.preview.emergentagent.com%2Fauth-callback (correctly URL-encoded backend callback URL); /auth-callback page renders the loading state with proper testID and gracefully redirects to /login when no session_id is in the URL hash; Lead Detail VERIFICATION panel renders all 4 rows (AI Trust Score, Poster, Post Freshness, Community-Verified); RUN CHECK button populates poster karma (11188), age (544d), Trusted label, and Live freshness status (demo source as expected); MARK LEGIT button toggles label between MARK LEGIT ↔ VERIFIED, counter goes 0→1→0 correctly. NO React render errors and NO pageerrors observed in console. All testIDs from the spec exist and are functional.
critical_code_review_comments: find_or_create_social_user correctly excludes _id and password_hash; bcrypt no longer stores hash for social users (empty string) — login endpoint still rejects them because verify_password('', '') returns False (bcrypt.checkpw raises and is caught). Good.
_verify_apple_identity_token correctly fetches JWKS, validates RS256 signature, skips audience check (commented why — bundle ID varies), enforces issuer == https://appleid.apple.com.
demo_poster_profile uses deterministic seed (sum of ord chars) — same author always returns same karma/age, which is good for stable UX in demo mode.
compute_poster_trust score capping (0-100) and label thresholds (>=70 Trusted, >=40 Caution else Risky) match the visual UI thresholds for icon coloring — consistent.
mark-verified is correctly idempotent for the toggle (set semantics) and only awards XP on the 'marked' transition, not on 'unmarked'.
Login screen correctly hides Apple button on web by checking Platform.OS === 'ios' AND appleAvailable — both gates required.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test@leadforge.io user. test_mark_verified_toggle leaves the lead's verified_by in same state as it found it (toggles twice). No new test data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features verified end-to-end. Reddit IP is blocked from this container so /api/leads/{id}/verify always uses demo_poster_profile + alive=true; this is expected per spec. Apple JWKS endpoint IS reachable from container (apple_auth returns 401 with proper 'Invalid Apple token' detail, not 502). Emergent OAuth session-data endpoint IS reachable (returns 401 for invalid session_id, not 502). Note: For full E2E Google sign-in test, you'd need a real Emergent OAuth flow — we only verified the redirect URL construction, which is exactly what the spec asked for. testIDs in use: google-signin-btn, apple-signin-btn (iOS only), auth-callback-screen, verification-panel, run-verification-btn, mark-verified-btn.
